meta.author: Dušan Milivojević
meta.description: Released in late 2017 by Dušan Milivojević, this preview showcases an early stage of a planned sequel to the 2014 Commodore 64 game Moonspire. Developed in collaboration with musician Ari Yliaho, it moves the action to a Draxx spaceship while retaining the exploration-based shoot-'em-up gameplay of the original and introducing updated graphics. Players explore a maze-like environment, hack at least 80% of the ship's computer terminals, and make their way to an evacuation pad. The project was never completed, although a larger unfinished version became available in 2021.
